common.close: BUTTON imperative: dismiss/close a dialog or panel (TR: Kapat).
common.default: NOUN/ADJ label for the default option in a list — not a verb.
research.inPanel: STATUS badge: this research is currently shown in the panel (adjective/state). TR→Açık, DE→Offen, FR→Ouvert, ES→Abierto. NEVER imperative (not Aç/Öffnen/Ouvrir).
tracker.chip.ready_to_send: STATUS chip fallback / search for ready_to_send section. Row chips use researchDone / savingDraft / mailInDraft instead.
tracker.chip.researchDone: STATUS chip: research finished, local mail ready, not yet in Gmail Drafts.
tracker.chip.savingDraft: STATUS chip while creating/uploading the Gmail draft (may show with spinner). Any row status.
tracker.chip.preparingMail: STATUS chip while the mail draft is being prepared (spinner). Any row status. TR: Mail hazırlanıyor…
tracker.mailMark.empty: Tooltip on a tiny empty ring beside the status chip: no outgoing mail has been prepared for this row.
tracker.mailMark.prepared: Tooltip on a tiny orange ring: a local mail exists but it is not in Gmail Drafts. TR: Mail hazır, Gmail taslakta değil.
tracker.mailMark.drafted: Tooltip on a tiny green ring: the prepared mail is sitting in Gmail Drafts. TR: Mail hazır ve Gmail taslakta.
tracker.action.clearPrepared: BUTTON title: delete the prepared mail for this row, including the Gmail draft if one exists. Sent mail is not deleted. TR: Hazırlanan maili sil.
tracker.action.clearPreparedHint: One-line explanation under the delete action. TR: CMAE'nin yazdığı metni ve varsa Gmail taslağını siler. Gönderilmiş maile dokunmaz.
tracker.action.openGmail: BUTTON: open the existing email thread in Gmail. Does not send. Stays visible even when a draft exists. TR: Yazışmayı Gmail'de aç.
tracker.action.openGmailHint: Hint under View the conversation. TR: Bu e-posta dizisini açar. Mail gönderilmez.
tracker.action.openGmailN: BUTTON title. {count} is the number of Gmail threads and MUST stay in the string so it is replaced with a number. TR: Gmail'de {count} yazışmayı aç.
tracker.action.openGmailNHint: Hint under the multi-thread Gmail action. Do not repeat {count}; the title already has it. TR: Hangisini açacağını seç. Mail gönderilmez.
tracker.sel.pause: BUTTON on the selection bar: pause every selected application. TR: Bu başvuruları duraklat.
tracker.sel.pauseHint: Hint under the selection-bar pause action. TR: Aktif listeden çıkarır. İstediğin zaman geri alırsın.
tracker.sel.resume: BUTTON on the selection bar: resume selected paused applications. TR: Bu başvuruları devam ettir.
tracker.sel.resumeHint: Hint under the selection-bar resume action. TR: Listeye geri alır. Durum bir sonraki senkronizasyonda güncellenir.
tracker.sel.clearHint: Hint under Clear selection. Unchecks rows only. TR: İşaretleri temizler. Başvurular aynı kalır.
tracker.action.createDraft: BUTTON: save the ready application email into Gmail Drafts. The user sends it. Not a Send button. TR: Başvuruyu Gmail Taslaklar'a kaydet.
tracker.action.createDraftHint: Hint: destination is Gmail Drafts; user sends. TR: Hazır maili Taslaklar'a koyar. Gönderimi sen yaparsın.
tracker.action.prepareApplication: BUTTON: rewrite the application email from research notes after the local template was deleted. TR: Başvuru mailini yaz.
tracker.action.prepareApplicationHint: Hint: uses company folder notes; then user can save to Gmail Drafts. TR: Klasördeki research notlarını kullanır.
tracker.action.prepareFollowUp: BUTTON: start writing a follow-up inside CMAE (tone picker). Nothing is saved or sent yet. TR: Takip maili yaz.
tracker.action.prepareFollowUpHint: Hint for write-follow-up. TR: Tonunu seçersin. Kaydetmeden önce metni okursun.
tracker.action.draftFollowUp: BUTTON: copy an already written follow-up into Gmail Drafts. User sends. TR: Takip mailini Taslaklar'a kaydet.
tracker.action.draftFollowUpHint: Hint. TR: Metni Gmail Taslaklar'a kopyalar. Gönderimi sen yaparsın.
tracker.action.prepareReply: BUTTON: write a reply in CMAE before saving. TR: Yanıt yaz.
tracker.action.prepareReplyHint: Hint. TR: Son mesajlarına cevap hazırlanır. Kaydetmeden önce okursun.
tracker.action.draftReply: BUTTON: save the reply into Gmail Drafts. TR: Yanıtı Taslaklar'a kaydet.
tracker.action.draftReplyHint: Hint. TR: Metni Gmail Taslaklar'a kopyalar. Gönderimi sen yaparsın.
tracker.action.prepareThanks: BUTTON: write a thank-you note after rejection. TR: Teşekkür notu yaz.
tracker.action.prepareThanksHint: Hint. TR: Red sonrası kısa bir not. Kaydetmeden önce okursun.
tracker.action.draftThanks: BUTTON: save the thank-you into Gmail Drafts. TR: Teşekkür notunu Taslaklar'a kaydet.
tracker.action.draftThanksHint: Hint. TR: Metni Gmail Taslaklar'a kopyalar. Gönderimi sen yaparsın.
tracker.action.pendingSend: BUTTON: open the unsent draft that is already in Gmail Drafts. Not the conversation thread. TR: Gönderilmemiş taslağı aç.
tracker.action.pendingSendHint: Hint. TR: Gmail Taslaklar'da bekliyor. Göndermek için oradan gönderirsin.
tracker.action.draftCreating: STATUS on a disabled menu row while the draft is saving. TR: Taslak Gmail'e kaydediliyor…
tracker.action.draftCreatingHint: Hint while saving. TR: Birkaç saniye sürer.
tracker.action.draftUnknown: BUTTON: draft state could not be confirmed; open Gmail Drafts to check. TR: Taslağı Gmail'de kontrol et.
tracker.action.draftUnknownHint: Hint. TR: Durumu doğrulanamadı. Taslaklar klasörüne bak.
tracker.action.pause: BUTTON: pause tracking this application (mark inactive). TR: Bu başvuruyu duraklat.
tracker.action.pauseHint: Hint. TR: Aktif listeden çıkar. İstediğin zaman geri alırsın.
tracker.action.resume: BUTTON: resume a paused application. TR: Bu başvuruyu devam ettir.
tracker.action.resumeHint: Hint. TR: Listeye geri alır. Durum bir sonraki senkronizasyonda güncellenir.
tracker.action.more: Tooltip on the … button that opens this menu. TR: Diğer işlemler.
tracker.error.clearPrepared: Error when clearing a prepared mail fails. TR: Hazırlanan mail silinemedi.
tracker.threadCard.from: Sender line on a thread card. {name} is a person or email. TR: Kimden: {name}.
tracker.threadCard.noSubject: Thread card title when the mail has no subject.
tracker.threadPick.title: Modal title: user must pick which email conversation to reply in.
tracker.threadPick.lead: Modal explanation. {company} and {count} are filled in. The draft is a reply inside the chosen thread.
tracker.chip.mailInDraft: STATUS chip: application mail is sitting in Gmail Drafts waiting for the user to send.
tracker.chip.needs_reply: STATUS chip: a reply is needed from the user — state, not a Reply button (TR: Yanıt / Yanıt bekleniyor, not Yanıtla as a command).
tracker.chip.needs_action: STATUS chip: user must open a link or form.
tracker.chip.waiting: STATUS chip: waiting on a dated return (participle/state).
tracker.chip.closed: STATUS chip: application closed/done (adjective). Not a Close button.
tracker.chip.inactive: STATUS chip: user paused this row (adjective).
tracker.section.ready_to_send: Section heading for applications ready to send.
help.tracker.helpStatusesTitle: Help subheading: glossary of tracker status meanings for end users.
help.tracker.status0Label: Status name in help — must match Ready to send section/chip wording in that locale.
help.tracker.status1Label: Status name in help — must match Reply needed wording in that locale.
help.tracker.status2Label: Status name in help — must match Action needed wording in that locale.
help.tracker.status3Label: Status name in help — must match Follow-up due wording in that locale.
help.tracker.status4Label: Status name in help — must match Waiting (dated) wording in that locale.
help.tracker.status5Label: Status name in help — must match Active conversations wording in that locale.
help.tracker.status6Label: Status name in help — must match Rejected wording in that locale.
help.tracker.status7Label: Status name in help — must match Closed wording in that locale.
help.tracker.status8Label: Status name in help — must match Inactive wording in that locale.
help.tracker.status9Label: Status name in help — must match Ignored wording in that locale.
tracker.recent.title: Section heading: sync highlight strip at top of tracker (noun).
tracker.recent.clear: BUTTON imperative: dismiss/clear the Recent strip (items stay in status sections).
tracker.recent.reasonNew: Short badge: newly created application row (adjective/noun).
tracker.recent.reasonMail: Short badge: existing row received new mail (noun phrase).
tracker.searchPlaceholder: Search input placeholder listing searchable fields (company, role, status, recipient).
tracker.searchAria: Accessible name for the tracker search field (noun phrase).
tracker.searchClear: BUTTON imperative: clear the search query.
tracker.searchEmpty: Empty state when search has no matches; {query} is the user's text.
tracker.metaCountFiltered: Toolbar count while filtering: {shown} matches out of {total} applications.
tracker.detail.waitingOnUs: Short status: ball is with the user (waiting on you).
tracker.detail.waitingOnThem: Short status: ball is with the company (waiting on them).
tracker.sentiment.positive: Adjective describing tone of the latest reply.
tracker.sentiment.negative: Adjective describing tone of the latest reply.
tracker.sentiment.neutral: Adjective describing tone of the latest reply.
tracker.action.waiting: STATUS: waiting — not a Wait button.
tracker.recipient.recommended: Short badge for AI-recommended recipient email (noun phrase). TR→AI önerisi.
tracker.recipient.optionRecommended: Select option label: {label} plus AI recommendation marker.
terminal.logMode: Tooltip for the simple/detail log switch (noun phrase).
terminal.close: BUTTON imperative: close the terminal panel.
terminal.cancel: BUTTON imperative: cancel the running job.
folders.empty: STATUS badge: folder has no files (adjective). TR→Boş.
folders.forAi: Badge: file is for CMAE internals.
folders.forUser: Badge: file is for the user to read.
mail.folder.inbox: Gmail folder name — keep as the locale’s usual mail-folder term.
mail.folder.sent: Gmail Sent folder name (noun) — not a verb.
workspaceFiles.jobLinksFit: Markdown field label: why this role fits the candidate (noun phrase).
fields.negotiable: Checkbox label: candidate is open to salary negotiation (idiom/phrase).
fields.cvLabel: Form label: name/tag for a CV file (noun).
fields.cvFamily: Form label: group id linking language variants of one CV (noun).
fields.cvFamilyHint: Help text: same family means translations of one CV; empty means its own role.
fields.cvFamilyPlaceholder: Placeholder examples for CV family id.
fields.cvTagsHint: Help text: role keywords for job-title match; position beats language.
settings.cvHint: Settings CV section: pick order is role tags then language within family.
versionGate.openRelease: BUTTON: open the product website (imperative + object — clear).
versionGate.dismiss: BUTTON: postpone update (adverb/interjection, not a verb tense).
sync.incrementalRouteSummary: Log line verbs skip/attach/create are English action codes in a compact log — translate surrounding words; keep action sense as nouns/states of the routing decision if natural.
